envelope.description: Rebuild the pane's shell: fixed comment panel in the VS Code theme

body.title: Rebuild the pane's shell: fixed comment panel in the VS Code theme
body.summary: Lay the shell out as a column with the header and the comment panel outside one scrolling region. Take every colour from VS Code theme variables and define the --it-* tokens from them. The comment panel is a rounded box with a field and round icon-only buttons that post one decision with the whole-document comment, stay disabled until the result arrives and show the result line.
acceptanceChecks: The comment panel and header stay outside the scrolling region
No terminal style, theme message or literal colour is used
The three buttons post one decision with the whole-document comment, are disabled until the result arrives, and feedback with no comment posts nothing
The section chooser and the functional, diagram and experience renderers still draw
The shell baseline and the assertions on the old layout and style are updated to the new shell, and one inline script, the nonce CSP and no remote origin are still asserted

tests.name: docs review shell: the comment panel and the header are outside the one scrolling region, and the shell's styles use --vscode-* variables with no terminal style and no theme switch

docs review shell: each of the three buttons posts one docs-decision with the whole-document comment and is disabled until the result arrives, the result line is shown, and feedback with no comment posts nothing
docs review shell: the existing section chooser, functional-requirement, diagram and experience renderers still draw
docs review shell: the shell is one inline script under a nonce CSP with no remote origin, and its recorded baseline is that of the new shell
